summary: No silent wrong solid found: 15 stored cases replayed live and matched, plus about 120 fresh probes (scale 1e-4 to 1e3, thin walls, near-vanish drafts 1e-5 from the limit, near-tie face words 4e-7 apart, 40 random multi-face draft-then-hollow cases against an independent plane closed form) were built exactly or refused. Two hand closed forms (whole draft of a box, L extrude draft, hollow after a rounded cylinder) agree with the truck. Defects are bookkeeping: the committed shell-draft.json is stale against its own builder, and a few evidence/sentence gaps.

replays.feature: hollow after round r1 on cylinder

replays.stored: 11335.5095 (OCCT and brep 11735.5095, both ignore the pocket)

replays.live: 13966.7726; hand integral for the unturned twin 13966.77

defects.problem: C/shell-draft.json is stale against its own builder and runs file: committed file says 94 rows, 43 supported, 1013 cases; shell-draft-runs.json holds 1100 cases and shell-draft-make-rows.mjs (run on a copy) rebuilds 100 rows, 46 supported. Six rows are missing from the committed file (closed hollow of 36 seeded random boxes/cylinders/prisms; closed hollow of a turned prism refused; 36 random mirrored boxes supported and swallowed-face refused; hollow after whole draft of cylinder/cone refused; hollow open after whole draft of prism/rectangle extrude) and two rows have older, narrower scopes (whole draft of rectangle/triangle extrude; whole draft with pull not along sides). Common rows are otherwise byte-identical.

defects.feature: hollow after a whole-shape round of a cylinder smaller than the wall (row 11)
defects.problem: supported on one case (hb2-cyl-round1-w2) whose only reference is brep-rs (OCCT refuses, no closed form). I confirmed the number independently by a Pappus closed form (4743.460 vs truck 4743.4608), so the result is right but the stored evidence is single-oracle.

defects.feature: closed hollow of a wedge, cone, extrude... (row 5)
defects.problem: refusal sentence says a closed hollow is 'only built for a plain box, cylinder, sphere or prism', but the sphere closed hollow is refused (row 3), so the sentence promises something the layer does not do.

the 4 pocket cases (dnc-pocket-*) have both OCCT and brep-rs 400 mm3 above the closed form (both ignore the pocket); row text reports only 'OCCT 84/4/4' without saying the two oracles are wrong the same way, so those cases rest on the closed form alone (hand check: pocket 8x10x5 = 400, consistent with truck).

defects.feature: curved hollow near the wall limit (rows 1, 24)
defects.problem: curved bar 3e-4 of volume cannot see a tiny cavity (cylinder r12, wall 11.99: cavity 4e-7 of the volume; truck 13570.14 vs exact 13571.67, 1.1e-4); existence of the cavity is guarded only by face count. Not wrong, but weaker than the planar 1e-9 bar. Also an inconsistent ceiling: cylinder open hollow refuses at wall 11.999 although a 0.001 cavity exists, and a wall of 1e-5 prints as 'a wall of 0' in the closed-hollow sentence.

notMeasured: Full 1100-case rerun (resource cap 1500M; replayed 15 cases + ~120 fresh probes instead)
Hollow after a very large coordinate scale (1e5): refused honestly (face pick), not investigated
Time claims (hang file, timings) were not rechecked
sigma (draft sign convention) is fixed from brep-rs on one case; a hand integral confirmed the sign on dw2-box-5 only
